content.text: The early round 2 results are in. Over the first 1281 days, P14 water-rate RMSE fell from 218 m³/d with the original fields to 63 m³/d. Water reached P15 and P16 too early. Their water rates at that time were 365 and 51, against historical values of 86 and 5. Round 3 will retain the P14 changes, reduce the enhancements to the lower P15 and P16 paths, and restore some pore volume to test whether breakthrough can be delayed.

Round 3 passed the original simulator's import checks and has begun rerunning from the initial time. I transferred computing resources from the earlier round 1 case to round 3 and retained its first 1912 days as diagnostic evidence. The plan is to compare the full-period oil and water curves for the completed baseline, round 2, and round 3. Only cases that finish the full run will be included in the full-period ranking.

The early round 3 response supports the correction. At day 1281, P15 water production fell from 365 m³/d in round 2 to 98 m³/d, against a historical 86 m³/d. Its early water-rate RMSE fell from 128 to 14. Over the same window, field oil/water RMSE at producing times fell from about 196 with the original fields to 45. P16 is still high at this point, and the late response has yet to be tested. I will continue the full-period run.

The comparison through day 1439 clarifies the remaining mismatches. The P14 water rate was 298 against a historical 602, the P16 water rate was 52 against 158, and P11 and P12 still produced too little water. I12-W began injecting water on day 1210. The simulated water saturation shows that the front on the static low-resistance path to P16 was still near the injector. The next round will test whether this connection is too weak, adjust inflow to the lower part of P14 and the arrival of water at P11 and P12, and continue to change only porosity and permeability.

In line with the objective you confirmed, I am comparing oil and water production curves for the field and every well across the whole history on the same basis. The original fields have completed 2891 days. Over the common first 2119 days, round 3 reduced field oil/water rate RMSE from about 1253 to 412 m³/d. Wells including P15 still show mismatches. This is a partial-period result. I will continue validating the candidates across the full history.
